title: Inventory security scope and freeze shared-control-plane work
acceptance: Every primary and corrective task has a content-addressed security/shared-state classification and explicit block reason.
Unclassified tasks and shared-control-plane artifacts fail closed before merge, deploy, credential access, live worker admission, or canonical status mutation.
Security-sensitive tasks are represented as security_blocked until an exact-catalog Human/Ops release decision is accepted.
Read-only audit and isolated fixture tests remain possible without touching shared state.
The runtime gate separation remains intact: runtime lock safety is pre-dispatch; protected verifier and Ed25519 completion remain final closeout only.
Two distinct fleet reviews, checks, exact source identity, rollback matrix, and redacted release decision are archived.
non_goals: No live status or activity-log mutation
No credentials, secrets, deploy, restart, broker, or capital side effect
dispatch_rules: Do not dispatch while security work is paused; only a clean fleet task worktree may implement the future gate.
Owner and reviewer must be distinct admitted fleet identities.
The planner may author the matrix and inspect evidence but may not implement product artifacts.
No held task is released by a task-local flag or by a fleet worker's self-approval.
